svg.title: Jev prune and rerank improve both quality and diversity
svg.desc: For the query "sugar canister", hybrid search returns one product type in the top 5 with nDCG@5 of 0.56. Jev prune returns two product types with nDCG@5 of 0.63. Jev rerank returns three product types with nDCG@5 of 0.79. A scatter plot of quality against diversity is followed by the five product photos each method returns.

g.text: Result diversity (unique product types in top 5)
